gloss: to yield to one another; to give way mutually; to compromise

definitions.gloss: to yield to one another; to give way mutually; to compromise
definitions.explanation: For two or more parties to each defer to the other, whether physically making room or backing down in a dispute. Carries a positive sense of mutual consideration.

examples.english: They offer each other the seat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{譲|ゆず}り{合|あ}って⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
examples.english: On narrow roads, cars give way to one another to pass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両者|りょうしゃ}→両者：11357_ryousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧{譲|ゆず}り{合|あ}えば、⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まとまる→まとまる：01642_matomaru⟧⟦はず→はず：01557_hazu⟧だ。
examples.english: If both sides give a little, the negotiation should come together.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{譲|ゆず}る→譲る：02323_yuzuru⟧ (to yield, to hand over) + ⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ (to do mutually). Describes reciprocal deference between parties.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{譲|ゆず}り{合|あ}う: to offer each other a seat
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{譲|ゆず}り{合|あ}う: to give way to one another on the road
- ⟦{互|たが}い→互い：03402_tagai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{譲|ゆず}り{合|あ}う: to compromise with each other

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{譲|ゆず}る→譲る：02323_yuzuru⟧: to yield; to hand over — one-directional; {譲|ゆず}り{合|あ}う is mutual
